title: One rule for what history the router and classifier are given on a follow-up, across chat surfaces
evidence: Router: done. routerTurn in app/lib/chat-router-stage.server.ts builds the router's input on web, Discord and YouTube; a YouTube follow-up passes its thread (US-15 AC75, Brad 2026-11-26). Left: YouTube's classifier reads the comment alone, while web and Discord classify with the same turn the router reads. (H415)
